subject.title: Exploring a chat-first Android surface for OpenClaw (discussion + possible focused upstreaming)

question: Should the official Android app stay companion/Overview-first, add an explicit chat-first mode, or move to a chat-first default?
rationale: Current code already has Chat and Talk entry points, but changing the default mobile surface and media scope affects Android pairing, permissions, release posture, and product positioning.

options.title: Invite focused slices
options.body: Keep the companion-node app shape for now while inviting narrow PRs for chat entry, media handling, and connectivity after Android owner scoping.

options.title: Adopt chat-first mode
options.body: Approve a first-class chat-first mode or default and require a design/proof plan covering pairing, media, permissions, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep external only
options.body: Decide the broad chat-first fork direction should remain external and close this discussion after documenting which small Android PRs are still welcome.

recommendation.title: Invite focused slices
recommendation.body: Keep the companion-node app shape for now while inviting narrow PRs for chat entry, media handling, and connectivity after Android owner scoping.

likelyOwner.reason: Ayaan is the named Android app owner and authored several central Android chat/setup commits.
